crossRefs.note: Don’t be afraid of sudden fear, neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it comes;
for Yahweh will be your confidence, and will keep your foot from being taken.
What the wicked fear, will overtake them, but the desire of the righteous will be granted.
When the whirlwind passes, the wicked is no more; but the righteous stand firm forever.
Let their table before them become a snare. May it become a retribution and a trap.
men fainting for fear, and for expectation of the things which are coming on the world: for the powers of the heavens…
“So be careful, or your hearts will be loaded down with carousing, drunkenness, and cares of this life, and that day…
For it will come like a snare on all those who dwell on the surface of all the earth.
For when they are saying, “Peace and safety,” then sudden destruction will come on them, like birth pains on a pregnant…
The kings of the earth, the princes, the commanding officers, the rich, the strong, and every slave and free person…
Before your pots can feel the heat of the thorns, he will sweep away the green and the burning alike.
The nations will rush like the rushing of many waters: but he will rebuke them, and they will flee far off, and will be…
Yahweh is slow to anger, and great in power, and will by no means leave the guilty unpunished. Yahweh has his way in…
Woe to those who are pregnant and to those who nurse infants in those days! For there will be great distress in the…
oppression, and anguish on every soul of man who does evil, to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.

translations.web: when calamity overtakes you like a storm, when your disaster comes on like a whirlwind, when distress and anguish come on you.
translations.bsb: when your dread comes like a storm, and your destruction like a whirlwind, when distress and anguish overwhelm you.
translations.kjv: When your fear cometh as desolation, and your destruction cometh as a whirlwind; when distress and anguish cometh
translations.asv: When your fear cometh as a storm, And your calamity cometh on as a whirlwind; When distress and anguish come upon you.
